newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-AMERICANS WIN THIRD ALFRED DUNHILL CUP TITLE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-AMERICANS WIN THIRD ALFRED DUNHILL CUP TITLE.

text.p: The top-seeded United States became the first three-time winners of the Alfred Dunhill Cup when they beat New Zealand 2-1 in the final on Sunday.
For the U.S. team, who won in 1989 and 1993, Mark O'Meara lost the opening match to Frank Nobilo 69-72 but Phil Mickelson beat Greg Turner 69-72 and and Steve Stricker defeated Grant Waite 67-73.
In the semifinals earlier on Sunday, the United States beat unseeded Sweden and New Zealand upset third-seeded South Africa, both by 2-1.
Each American won 100,000 pounds ($158,000). The New Zealanders, who were seeded seventh, each took 50,000 pounds ($79,000).
